DYNAMIC_TOKENS.TrackedAttributeHint: The attribute used to calculate HP percentage for image swapping.
DYNAMIC_TOKENS.PreviewHpHint: Scrub a hypothetical HP% to preview which image would resolve and which threshold is active. Starts at the token's current HP%; doesn't change actor data.
DYNAMIC_TOKENS.ThresholdsHint: Each row sets the image to use once HP drops to at most that percent (the tightest matching row wins).
DYNAMIC_TOKENS.StatusOverridesHint: Map a status condition to an image, checked before HP thresholds. The first active status in this list wins outright.
DYNAMIC_TOKENS.ImagePoolsHint: Add extra images to a threshold to pick one at random (optionally weighted) each time that band becomes active.
DYNAMIC_TOKENS.NoThresholds: Add at least one threshold in the Appearance tab first.
